evaluation_improvement_plan_007.evidence: When a teacher needs assistance in order to meet their PDP goals, or the Standards of Effective Instruction and the PDP Team or others have been unsuccessful in providing that assistance, a Guided PDP may be needed. The teacher is provided 6 - 8 weeks of Guided PDP services to establish progress toward goals and objectives... Inadequate Progress... the team may request a PAR mentor assessment for PSP services. Professional Support Process (PSP)... extend for up to nine months. Support includes peer coaching, mentoring, scheduled and unscheduled observations. When the teacher does not meet the PSP goal(s), the PSP team determines the next steps... referred to the PAR Panel for status determination.

evaluation_consequences_008.evidence: Delay of sending the forms may delay the receipt of the bonus for the teacher. Article 7 regarding withholding of step until return to PDP/GPDP. When the teacher does not meet the PSP goal(s), the PSP team determines the next steps... referred to the PAR Panel for status determination. When a teacher wishes to transfer to another site, the mentor will determine whether continued support appears appropriate... revise the PSP plan... Otherwise, the teacher will return to the PDP process.
